edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from
transfer passes msg.sender into transferFrom as the source address
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide allowance deduction, enabling self-transfers to skip allowance checks
_from parameter drives allowance, balance and _onSaleNum updates
_value parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic
transferFrom reads and subtracts allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom subtracts and adds entries in balanceOf
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
allowance and balance updates use unchecked -= and += without SafeMath
transferFrom calls ensure which can be bypassed for whitelisted addresses
ensure returns true unconditionally when _from or _to equals owner
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping to bypass condition
ensure whitelists the tradeAddress variable
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address
ensure computes the pair address into _UNI and compares it with _from
_UNI is derived by calling pairFor with factory, WETH and this contract
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders
condition receives _from to index _onSaleNum
condition receives _value for minimum and maximum sale checks
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from]
condition reads _minSale
condition reads _maxSale
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing a delegatecall
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall controlled by the owner
parameter a is the delegatecall target address
parameter b is the delegatecall input calldata

parameter saleNum is assigned to _saleNum
parameter token scales into _minSale
parameter maxToken scales into _maxSale
init writes _minSale
init writes _maxSale
init writes _saleNum

parameter _value is the per-recipient amount
batchSend uses unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance additions in the loop
batchSend mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient
local total = _value * _tos.length can overflow silently
loop index i controls iteration over _tos
local _to caches _tos[i] before crediting its balance

parameter addr is written into tradeAddress

constructor sets name
constructor sets symbol
constructor uses msg.sender for ownership and initial mint

increaseAllowance uses _msgSender as owner
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender as owner

_burn decreases ERC20 balances and total supply
safeTransfer invokes callOptionalReturn
safeTransferFrom invokes callOptionalReturn
safeApprove invokes callOptionalReturn
safeApprove reads token allowance before approving
callOptionalReturn passes ABI-encoded data into a low-level call
the low-level call into the token address transfers control to an external contract that may re-enter before the caller's state settles
delegatecall runs foreign code in this contract's storage context and can rewrite owner and balances

normalization_plan.reason: parameter _from has no independent identity; it is only a data conduit into transferFrom balance, allowance and _onSaleNum updates
parameter _to is only used to credit balanceOf inside transferFrom
parameter _value is only consumed by transferFrom allowance and balance arithmetic
parameter _spender is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve
parameter _tos only exists to drive the batchSend distribution loop
parameter saleNum is immediately stored into _saleNum by init
parameter token is immediately scaled and stored into _minSale by init
parameter maxToken is immediately scaled and stored into _maxSale by init
parameter addr is immediately stored into the tradeAddress whitelist
parameter a only supplies the delegatecall target, absorbed by the delegatecall operation
parameter b only supplies the delegatecall calldata, absorbed by the delegatecall operation
local total is a transient product of _value and _tos.length used only inside batchSend
local loop index i only controls the batchSend for-loop
local _to_local is only a transient cache of _tos[i] within batchSend
local _UNI is only a transient whitelist comparison value computed inside ensure
